slides.title: SARA AI 2.5 Pro — The Autonomous AI Employee
slides.subtitle: Beyond Chatbots: Real-Time Multimodal Voice, Vision, and 500+ Enterprise Automations

slides.title: The Problem: Passive LLMs & Context Fragmentation
bullets: Existing AI (ChatGPT, Claude web) are passive text boxes requiring manual prompting and copy-pasting.
Developers & agency teams waste 20+ hours weekly switching between Slack, Discord, terminals, CRM, and code editors.
Hiring junior engineers or automation operators costs $4,000–$8,000/month per seat with lengthy training.

slides.title: The Solution: SARA AI 2.5 Pro
bullets: An autonomous, proactive multimodal co-pilot living right on your desktop.
Zero-Amnesia 3-Tier SQLite Memory: Retains every project, habit, and client context permanently.
Direct OS Manipulation: Interacts with VS Code, Windows terminals, MS Paint, files, and browsers autonomously.
Integrated 415+ n8n Automations: Bridges WhatsApp, Discord, Email, Notion, and databases seamlessly.

slides.title: The Technology Moat
bullets: Multi-Model Neural Gateway: APInex fallback across 9 top LLMs (DeepSeek V3/R1, LLaMA 3.3 70B, Claude 3.5) with sub-2s cascade.
Web Audio FFT Viseme Engine: High-precision real-time procedural mouth shapes synced to vocal spectrum.
Zero-File Procedural Audio: Dynamic oscillators generate HUD audio, alerts, and feedback without static audio asset overhead.
Verified Reliability: 250/250 Automated Unit Test Suite passing 100% green.

pillars.3D Live Avatar: Three.js GPU-accelerated rendering with gaze tracking & procedural emotion states.
pillars.120 Core Tools: Hardware telemetry, deep C: drive cleaner (5.26 GB+ reclaim), Paint drawing, Bing scraping.
pillars.Google Antigravity Bridge: Direct pair programming & autonomous subagent orchestration.
